title: Zero-shot Video Moment Retrieval With Off-the-Shelf Models

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: On the QVHighlights benchmark for VMR, we vastly improve performance of previous zero-shot approaches by at least 2.5x on all metrics and reduce the gap between zero-shot and state-of-the-art supervised by over 74%.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: It is becoming increasingly clear that data collection is a major bottleneck for progress in machine learning (Roh et al., 2019); it is quite expensive to collect high-quality human-annotated data for a given task of interest.
